items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: The interviewee mentions Joe Henderson in the context of transcribed recordings ('The same thing with John Coltrane of course, Joe Henderson and Sonny Rollins. It’s there on a silver platter.') and as a member of Miles Davis's band ('Another time I saw them with Joe Henderson and Wayne at Lennie’s o

ctx.x: …originator than a really good copy cat. That’s a fantastic thing because in today’s world nobody learns how to play by walking out of a cave one day and they learn how to play. You have to know the history of this. You listen to early John Coltrane you can hear Dexter Gordon in it, you can hear Sonny Rollins in it, you can hear Jimmy Heath, you can hear of course Charlie Parker in everybody. But you know etcetera, etcetera. And then you can hear later Dexter and there’s some Coltrane things in there you know. So…

there for sure and Newk that he tips his hat to. And early Sonny Rollins if there’s no Charlie Parker there’s no Sonny Rollins. Just the language. So everybody’s getting something from somebody. At a certain point you say I breathe I’m valid. I’m going to listen to myself and try to do, get my sound — you don’t even have to try. You can’t get away from your sound even if you try to sound like somebody else you’re just going to end up sounding like you trying to sound like somebody else. So you say yeah, I’m going…
